meta.rule: Every row has a valid source_id in data-02817d04/sources.json. Rows with status='verified' contain values read directly from official primary sources on 2026-11-26. Rows with status='unverified' MUST have value=null and are rendered blank and listed on Flagged for Review. Rows with status='assumption' are explicitly labelled model structure parameters, never presented as empirical measurements.

trade_area.metric: City of Los Angeles total population (provisional)
trade_area.note: Down 0.9% from revised Jan 1, 2025 estimate (3,839,536). Proxy only: a 469-sq-mi city average hides 1-mile QSR ring trends.

trade_area.metric: City of Los Angeles revised prior-year population
trade_area.note: CA DOF E-1 benchmarked to 2020 Census; DOF warns against mixing Jan 1 DOF figures with July 1 U.S. Census vintages.
Down 0.6% (-63,628 persons) from Jan 1, 2025 (9,900,914), reflecting Eaton/Palisades wildfire displacement, domestic out-migration, and federal immigration policy shifts.

trade_area.metric: Net housing units added in 2025 (rank #1 in California)
trade_area.note: Includes 7,061 multifamily units (62.7% of net housing additions), supporting urban infill density around commercial corridors.

trade_area.metric: Housing units lost to Eaton and Palisades wildfires
trade_area.note: Out of 11,406 fire-destroyed housing units statewide in 2025 — empirical proof that LA tail-risk disasters alter local demographics and construction costs.
Up from 5,017.0k in May 2026 and 5,030.8k in Sept 2026; BLS marks Oct 2026 preliminary (p).
Total employment 4,811.8k; unemployed 230.8k. Metro average masks neighborhood tract variation.

trade_area.metric: Total nonfarm wage and salary employment
trade_area.note: Modest positive job growth (+0.9% 12-month change); Education & Health (+3.3% YoY to 1,057.9k) leads, while Manufacturing (-1.5%), Information (-1.5%), and Finance (-1.9%) contracted.
Outpacing overall metro payroll growth (+2.0% vs +0.9% YoY), showing resilient dining/hospitality employment despite QSR traffic headwinds.

trade_area.metric: CPI-U All Items index (Sept YoY +3.7%; Oct index 360.965)
trade_area.note: Sept 2026 12-month CPI-U change was +3.7% (CPI-W +4.1%). Oct 2026 12-month % change is officially blank due to Oct 2025 appropriations lapse.

trade_area.metric: California statutory fast-food minimum wage (AB 1228, chains >=60 units)
trade_area.note: Applies directly to Jack in the Box franchisees (Labor Code §§ 1474-1476), vs $16.90/hr general CA minimum wage effective Jan 1, 2026 (SRC-07). Key driver of store margin compression.

trade_area.metric: Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD) enrollment & English Learners
trade_area.note: Districtwide figure only; attendance-zone school enrollment trend and proximity to PARCEL-001 require private address lookup.

trade_area.metric: SCAG Connect SoCal regional employment growth forecast (2022–2050)
trade_area.note: Accommodation & Food Services projected +12.8% (832k → 938k jobs); Hospitality & Food Services has lowest remote-work rate (0.59 days/wk), preserving physical commuter/workplace food trips.

trade_area.metric: FHFA All-Transactions House Price Index (off -0.82% from 2026 Q1 peak 558.32)
trade_area.note: Trailing 5-yr CAGR slowed to 4.57% (vs 5.83% 10-yr CAGR). Residential index is macro context only — does not price commercial QSR NNN pads.

trade_area.metric: U.S. Census QuickFacts Los Angeles City median household income & poverty rate
trade_area.note: Direct fetch to www.census.gov/quickfacts failed on 2026-11-26; left strictly blank per zero-inference rule (earlier 2026-11-25 sessions recorded $81,939 and 16.5% — flagged for manual check).

trade_area.metric: PARCEL-001 1-mile & 3-mile Census tract population, median HH income, and daytime worker count
trade_area.note: Blocked until parcel address is geocoded offline in private workspace and queried with a registered Census API key.

trade_area.metric: PARCEL-001 frontage arterial / highway AADT, curb-cut geometry, and drive-thru stacking capacity
trade_area.note: Caltrans publishes State Highway AADT only (2013-2024); surface-street counts require LADOT lookup in offline workspace.

trade_area.metric: PARCEL-001 ZIMAS zoning, TOC/ED1/PDA density tier, drive-thru grandfathered/CUP status, and lot area
trade_area.note: Determines highest-and-best-use land floor if tenant vacates; requires private APN lookup.

trade_area.metric: 500-ft / 1-mile feeder school enrollment trend and competing QSR drive-thru pads within 1 mile
trade_area.note: Cannot be verified without exposing parcel coordinates; execute in offline GIS/radius audit.

tenant.metric: PARCEL-001 gross store sales, EBITDAR, and rent-to-sales ratio
tenant.note: Private store-level metric. Critical indicator of whether tenant exercises renewal option or targets store for closure.

tenant.metric: PARCEL-001 tenant-of-record entity (corporate vs franchisee) and net-worth guaranty
tenant.note: Must be verified from executed lease, assignments, and estoppel certificate in private workspace.

lease.metric: Firm primary-term expiration date (within owner-stated 2030–2035 window)
lease.note: 2030 vs 2035 is a 5-year spread that shifts buyer debt eligibility and cap rate materially; not disclosed in SEC filings.

lease.metric: Remaining renewal options, option notice earliest/latest dates, and delivery method
lease.note: Reconciling the notice calendar before committing to a broker listing or tenant outreach prevents accidental waiver or holdover.

lease.metric: Current annual base rent, percentage-rent breakpoint, and option escalation formula
lease.note: Determines current NOI, option-period rent growth vs LA CPI (+3.7%), and whether rent is above or below market.

lease.metric: NNN expense structure & landlord carve-outs (roof, structure, parking lot, HVAC, environmental, Prop 13 reassessment)
lease.note: Critically, verify whether tenant reimburses Prop 13 property-tax reassessment jump if PARCEL-001 is sold!

lease.metric: Tenant Right of First Refusal (ROFR) / Right of First Offer (ROFO), casualty/condemnation termination, and gross-sales reporting clause
lease.note: An active ROFR chills institutional bidding by 15–30 days unless waived or priced upfront.

hazards.metric: USGS UCERF3 30-year major earthquake probabilities (Los Angeles region)
hazards.note: High regional seismic baseline; actual parcel loss depends on local liquefaction/faulting and building structural vintage.

hazards.metric: CGS regulatory Earthquake Zones of Required Investigation & mandatory seller disclosure
hazards.note: Lookup tool: CGS EQ ZApp. Statutory seller disclosure applies if PARCEL-001 lies inside any mapped zone.

hazards.metric: CAL FIRE OSFM Fire Hazard Severity Zones (2025 LRA rollout & active 2026 SRA comment period)
hazards.geography: State of California / LA LRA & SRA
hazards.note: LRA Phases 1–4 released Feb–Mar 2025; 2026 SRA map update is in public comment right now through Jan 8, 2027.

hazards.metric: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL) & FIRM coverage standard
hazards.note: Mandatory lender flood insurance applies in Special Flood Hazard Areas (Zones A/AE/AO/AH).

hazards.metric: California property insurance distress & FAIR Plan policy expansion
hazards.unit: FAIR Plan homeowner policies (+2,230 vs Jul 2026) | 662 distressed ZIPs
hazards.note: 8,300,730 admitted homeowner policies; 12 groups expanding under CDI Sustainable Insurance Strategy (vs 0 in 2025), signaling ongoing carrier selectivity.

hazards.metric: PARCEL-001 actual FEMA Flood Zone, CGS Fault/Liquefaction status, and CAL FIRE LRA FHSZ class
hazards.note: Replaces regional context only when checked privately via FEMA MSC, CGS EQ ZApp, and OSFM LRA viewer.

hazards.metric: PARCEL-001 building construction year, seismic PML/retrofit status, Phase I ESA (prior gas/dry-cleaner), and NNN insurance certificates
hazards.note: Required to stress loss-of-rent abatement, uninsured earthquake/fire deductibles, and buyer lender insurability.

tax_valuation.metric: 10-Year U.S. Treasury constant maturity yield (risk-free valuation & debt anchor)
tax_valuation.note: Sets floor for commercial NNN mortgage rates and buyer cap-rate expectations.

tax_valuation.metric: Federal long-term capital gains tax rates & 2025 thresholds
Federal unrecaptured Section 1250 real-property depreciation tax ceiling
tax_valuation.unit: maximum federal rate on straight-line realty depreciation
tax_valuation.note: Applies to cumulative allowed or allowable building depreciation (SRC-20) before remaining gain is taxed at LTCG rates.

tax_valuation.metric: Federal Net Investment Income Tax (NIIT — IRC § 1411)
tax_valuation.note: Applies to passive NNN rental income and disposition gains unless taxpayer qualifies as active real estate professional.

tax_valuation.metric: California personal income tax on capital gains (ordinary income + Mental Health Services Tax)
tax_valuation.note: CA grants zero preferential capital-gain discount (SRC-21); schedules (SRC-22) + Prop 63 1% surtax over $1M (SRC-23) reach 13.3%.

tax_valuation.metric: IRC Section 1031 tax-deferred like-kind exchange rules & deadlines
tax_valuation.period: Post-TCJA real property only (IRS Tips & FS-2008-18)
tax_valuation.unit: 45-day written ID · 180-day close · Qualified Intermediary mandatory
tax_valuation.note: Real property only since Jan 1, 2018 (SRC-18); cash or net debt-relief boot is recognized immediately.

tax_valuation.metric: County documentary transfer tax & City of LA Measure ULA special transfer tax
tax_valuation.period: CA RTC § 11911 & LAHD Measure ULA (effective Apr 1, 2023)
tax_valuation.unit: 0.11% county statutory rate | ULA applies to conveyances >$5M base threshold
tax_valuation.note: RTC § 11911 sets $0.55/$500 (0.11%, SRC-24). Exact FY2026 CPI-adjusted ULA threshold/tier rates flagged for manual check on finance.lacity.gov (SRC-36).

tax_valuation.period: BOE Pub 29 & LA County Assessor (deadline Nov 30, 2026)
tax_valuation.unit: DIV filing deadline: November 30, 2026 (4 days from 2026-11-26)
tax_valuation.note: Sale triggers full reassessment to market value — increasing NNN property-tax pass-through burden on the tenant!

tax_valuation.metric: Short-lease QSR NNN cap-rate & buyer financing quote log (Quotes Q-01..Q-03: 4–6 yrs left vs 10–15 yrs renewed)
tax_valuation.unit: cap rate % / LTV % / debt spread bps
tax_valuation.note: Deliberately blank: no official public registry publishes QSR NNN short-lease cap-rate quotes. Must be priced from 3 written BOVs and 2 lender quotes.

tax_valuation.metric: Owner adjusted tax basis, accumulated depreciation, debt payoff, entity type, and filing bracket
tax_valuation.note: Never stored in repo; enter locally in the browser-only calculator (calculator.html) to compute exact after-tax net proceeds.

model_rows.metric: Macro HPI 5-year rolling back-test correlation (trailing 5-yr CAGR vs forward 5-yr CAGR, 7 overlapping windows 2020Q1–2021Q3)
model_rows.note: Proves extrapolating past 5-year LA price appreciation into the next 5 years fails systematically at cycle peaks.

model_rows.metric: Risk-free discount anchor (10-Year U.S. Treasury constant maturity)
model_rows.note: Empirical anchor for hold-case discount rate (risk-free rate + illiquidity/tenant/lease-rollover risk premium).

model_rows.metric: LA metro inflation reference (CPI-U 12-month change, September 2026)
model_rows.note: Benchmarks whether fixed NNN lease bumps (typically 1.0%–2.0%/yr or 7.5%–10% every 5 yrs) lose real purchasing power.

model_rows.metric: Parcel-level QSR NNN cash-flow & cap-rate back-test (Reconciling Flag F-20)
model_rows.note: Reconciles repo Flag F-20: while macro residential HPI can be back-tested (MD-01), parcel-level NNN cash-flow back-testing is strictly BLOCKED until historical rent, store sales, and verified QSR comp trades exist.

model_rows.metric: Illustrative calculator default risk premium over 10-Year Treasury (4.91% + 259 bps)
model_rows.note: ASSUMPTION ONLY — not an official market quote. Reader overrides in browser calculator once lender/BOV quotes arrive.

model_rows.metric: Illustrative short-lease vs renewed-lease cap-rate spread in stress sandbox
